text: JFE Holdings, Inc. is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (Prime Market). Its largest shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) with 15.25% and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account) with 5.83%, followed by Nippon Life (2.49%) and employee shareholder associations.
short: JFE Holdings is listed on TSE Prime; top holders are trust banks.
